sloka: ते प्रयाता महात्मानः पार्थिवास्ते प्रहृष्टवत् ।गजवाजिसहस्रौघैः कम्पयन्तो वसुन्धराम् ।। ७.३९.१ ॥
transliteration: te prayātā mahātmānaḥ pārthivāste prahṛṣṭavat ।gajavājisahasraughaiḥ kampayanto vasundharām ।। 7.39.1 ॥

translations.english: Those great-souled kings departed joyfully, shaking the earth with their throngs of thousands of elephants and horses.
